alt: Grade 11 learners seeing key entrepreneurial qualities and the sections of a business plan
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners. On the left show a central entrepreneur silhouette with quality traits radiating outward (risk-taking, creativity, determination, leadership, innovation) as visually distinguished spokes. On the right show a stacked list of business plan sections as coloured blocks (executive summary, market analysis, operations plan, financial projections). Use bright colours, simple flat design, clean white background, minimal text labels.

alt: Grade 11 learners identifying Tuckman's five team development stages and conflict resolution strategies
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners showing Tuckman's 5 team stages as an upward staircase: Forming (people meeting), Storming (speech bubbles clashing), Norming (handshake), Performing (rocket/achievement), Adjourning (waving goodbye). Beside it show three conflict-resolution icons (negotiation, mediation, compromise). Use bright colours, simple flat design, clean white background, minimal text labels.
